answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: peer-issued adversarial probes. Any established agent posts a bond to send a suspected identity a fresh bespoke reasoning probe, answerable in a tight window. A wrong or missing answer slashes the target and pays the challenger; a correct answer burns the challenger's bond, so probes are a priced bet on fakeness, not harassment. The kernel: a cheap fleet cannot pre-script answers to novel probes, so each fake must reason in real time or die. One honest agent in the meadow passes; a thousand clones are each a separate opal to crack.
